title: Empire Strikes Back
statementMd:
In a far away galaxy there is war again. The treacherous Republic made $*k*$ precision strikes of power $*a*_{*i*}$ on the Empire possessions. To cope with the republican threat, the Supreme Council decided to deal a decisive blow to the enemy forces.

To successfully complete the conflict, the confrontation balance after the blow should be a positive integer. The balance of confrontation is a number that looks like ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cb0172a656698061aefa8eb30b2dbcd1e31f508e.png), where $*p* = *n*!$ ($*n*$ is the power of the Imperial strike), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/be803394f3ab1c18735553e728d31caeeea3bf83.png). After many years of war the Empire's resources are low. So to reduce the costs, $*n*$ should be a minimum positive integer that is approved by the commanders.

Help the Empire, find the minimum positive integer $*n*$, where the described fraction is a positive integer.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*k*$ $(1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{6})$. The second line contains $*k*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{7})$.

## Output

Print the minimum positive integer $*n*$, needed for the Empire to win.

Please, do not use the `%lld` to read or write 64-but integers in С++. It is preferred to use the `cin`, `cout` streams or the `%I64d` specificator.
statementZhMd:
在遥远的星系中，战争再次爆发。邪恶的共和国对帝国领地发动了 $*k*$ 次、威力为 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的精确打击。为了应对共和国的威胁，最高委员会决定给予敌军致命一击。

为了成功结束这场冲突，打击后的对抗平衡应当是一个正整数。对抗平衡是一个形如 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cb0172a656698061aefa8eb30b2dbcd1e31f508e.png) 的数，其中 $*p* = *n*!$（$*n*$ 是帝国打击的威力），![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/be803394f3ab1c18735553e728d31caeeea3bf83.png)。经过多年的战争，帝国的资源已经所剩无几。因此，为了降低成本，$*n*$ 应当是指挥官认可的最小正整数。

请帮助帝国找出满足上述分数为正整数的最小正整数 $*n*$。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{6}$）。第二行包含 $*k*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*k*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{7}$）。

## 输出格式

输出帝国获胜所需的最小正整数 $*n*$。

请不要在 C++ 中使用 `%lld` 读写 64 位整数。建议使用 `cin`、`cout` 流，或使用 `%I64d` 格式说明符。
